Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.
Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.
You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).
This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.
Tasks
Your core mandate sits on three priorities.
1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health
Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer.
Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines.
2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation
Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth.
Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each
Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them.
Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited.
3. Benchmark Reports and Growth
This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority.
Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up.
4. PPC Management and Optimization
Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores.
Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support.

Required
5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people
Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption.
Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations.
Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease.
Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't.
Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards.
A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges.

Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision
Experience building benchmark reports or original research content
Familiarity with WordPress as a headless CMS or similar flexible content management systems
B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software
Experience with PPC management and optimization

About Lumiform
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers.

Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy.
Shape a major growth channel from scratch. Benchmark reports and AEO strategy will drive significant value for the company
Work fully remote and choose where you get things done
If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough.

An “Armed forces service medal veteran” means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.
Creating essential chemistry that the world needs
At Chemours, our people are redefining how the world thinks of chemistry by approaching everything we do with a commitment to delivering Trusted Chemistry that creates better lives and helps communities thrive. That begins with how we use our science, data, and technical expertise to develop market-leading products with high levels of performance, sustainability and safety.
Powered by chemistry, our products are used in applications that make the products we rely on, processes and new technologies possible. In key sectors such as clean energy, advanced electronics, high-performance computing and AI, climate-friendly cooling, and high-quality paints and coatings for homes and industrial infrastructure, sustainable solutions and more modern living depend on Chemours chemistry.
Chemours is seeking a Technical Marketing Specialist TSS to join our growing Thermal & Specialized Solutions team. This position is remote based in Germany and reports directly to the Regional Technical Manager EMEA. The role primarily supports customers and projects across the DACH region, the Netherlands and the Nordics, while also contributing to broader European initiatives.

The refrigeration and HVAC industry is undergoing one of its biggest transitions in decades. Regulations are evolving, refrigerants are changing, and manufacturers are continuously evaluating how to improve environmental performance without compromising safety, efficiency or reliability.
As Technical Marketing Specialist, you will help customers navigate that transition.
Working at the intersection of engineering, application development, business development and technical marketing, you will collaborate with OEMs, consultants, end-users, retailers, universities and industry organizations across Europe to support the qualification and adoption of next-generation refrigerants. Through technical projects, market intelligence and customer engagement, you will help translate industry challenges into practical solutions and business opportunities.
This is not a traditional marketing role. It is a highly visible technical position where you will influence customers, support industry initiatives and help shape the future of sustainable cooling technologies.
The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:
Lead application development projects within refrigeration, air-conditioning and heat pump markets.
Support OEMs and customers with the qualification and implementation of next-generation refrigerants.
Serve as a technical expert and trusted advisor for customers and industry stakeholders.
Identify and develop technical projects that support business growth and market adoption.
Analyze field trial and application data and provide recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
Develop technical papers, case studies and conference presentations.
Monitor market developments, customer needs and competitive activity to support business strategy.
Support codes, standards and regulatory activities across Europe.
Build relationships with universities, industry associations and standardization committees.
Collaborate closely with Technical Marketing, Business Development, Product Management, Sales, Regulatory and R&D teams globally.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Several years of experience within refrigeration, HVAC, heat pumps or related thermal systems industries.

Experience working with refrigerants, refrigeration systems, HVAC technologies or heat pumps.
Experience engaging with customers, OEMs, consultants or other external industry stakeholders.
Strong analytical and project management capabilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Fluency in German and English.
Ability to independently manage projects and operate effectively in a matrix environment.

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Agoda's Brand team is a diverse group of strategists, brand managers, media planners, project managers, visual designers, and creatives. We are master collaborators who help shape and protect what consumers, business partners, and employees see, hear, and feel about Agoda to generate trust, desire, and long-term brand loyalty. As guardians of the Agoda brand, we combine creativity, data, and consumer insight to build recognizable identity and deliver meaningful experiences across markets.

The Agoda Ambassador program brings together creators, agencies, and Agoda teams to grow the business through authentic, performance-led content. The program operates across two verticals: Activities and Accommodations.

This global individual-contributor role will lead the Activities vertical end to end, from creator acquisition and activation through agency partnerships, content growth, business strategy, and performance management.

The role will also lead the engagement vertical across both Activities and Accommodations, own the program's cross-vertical automation agenda, and support broader Accommodations priorities where required.

Success requires a strong commercial mindset, operational discipline, analytical fluency, and the ability to influence creators, agencies, and internal stakeholders.
In this role, you'll get to
Program strategy and business growth

· Lead end-to-end business and operational ownership of the Activities vertical within the Agoda Ambassador program.

· Develop and execute strategies to grow Activities bookings, active creators, posting frequency, and relevant content supply.

· Use data and business insights to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and prioritize initiatives.

· Work closely with the Activities Marketing team to create and activate promotional codes that support creator campaigns and business growth.

· Support broader Accommodations and Brand team priorities where required, while maintaining focus on core Activities metrics.
Creator, agency, and partner management

· Drive creator acquisition, onboarding, activation, and ongoing engagement for Activities.

· Scale agency partnerships by unblocking the onboarding pipeline and directly managing relationships with at least three agencies.

· Build trusted relationships with creators and partners, communicate expectations clearly, and resolve issues that affect participation or performance.
Engagement leadership across Activities and Accommodations

· Lead the Agoda Ambassador engagement vertical across both Activities and Accommodations, defining the engagement strategy, priorities, and operating rhythm for creators and agencies.

· Own the cross-vertical engagement charter, including content calendars, creator and agency communications, email responses, surveys, and the rollout of new propositions.

· Design and deliver initiatives that increase creator participation, posting frequency, content creation, and sustained program activity across both verticals.

· Use engagement and performance data to identify opportunities, refine communications, and improve creator and agency effectiveness.
Content activation and program operations

· Plan and activate creator content for Activities across relevant social platforms and markets.

· Coordinate product and supply workflows with internal teams, balancing partner needs with program and business performance.

· Manage multiple workstreams across creators, agencies, marketing, product, technology, supply, and Brand stakeholders in a fast-paced global environment.

· Provide product and technical support by identifying issues, coordinating with the right teams, and driving them through to resolution.
Automation, analytics, and performance

· Lead the automation of the Agoda Ambassador program across both Activities and Accommodations to improve efficiency, scalability, and partner experience.

· Track, analyze, and communicate program performance, including daily Activities bookings, the number of active creators generating at least one booking, creator posting activity, and the volume of Activities content created.

· Build clear performance views and translate data into recommendations, actions, and business decisions.

· Continuously improve operating processes, identify bottlenecks, and create scalable ways of working across teams and external partners.
What you'll need to succeed

· 4-5 years of relevant experience in social media, affiliate marketing within an online business, creator or influencer programs, agency management, partnerships, or a related field.

· Demonstrated experience managing creator, agency, or partner relationships and delivering measurable commercial or engagement outcomes.

· Strong analytical skills and hands-on comfort with SQL and Tableau, with the ability to turn data into clear business insights and growth strategies.

· Experience using social monitoring tools to understand content activity, engagement, and program performance.

· Experience with AI tools such as Claude, or a strong willingness and ability to learn and apply them to improve program operations.

· Excellent stakeholder management, agency negotiation, creator communication, commercial thinking, and project management skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.

· Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a bias for action, with the ability to lead complex cross-functional work and manage multiple priorities independently.

· High proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively across global teams and external partners.

Job Title: Performance Marketing Manager (Web)
Department: Growth & Marketing
Employment type: Full-Time
About ImagineArt
We're redefining how the world creates and designs.
ImagineArt is one of the fastest-growing GenAI companies in the world. We've scaled faster than most funded startups, with zero outside funding.
$35M+ ARR crossed this year
100M+ social impressions
Built and shipped our own image generation model, now ranked #3 globally for photo realism
No funding. No shortcuts. Just a sharp, driven team building one of the strongest GenAI products in the world, and we're just getting started.
Almost all of that growth has come from people finding us and subscribing on the web. We are now hiring someone to own that engine properly.

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition for our web product.
This is a web-first role. You will own the funnel from ad impression to paid subscription, across Meta, TikTok and Google, with real budget behind it from day one. ImagineArt is a consumer subscription product, so the numbers that matter to you are CAC, payback window and trial to paid conversion, not lead volume or MQLs.
The honest constraint in this role is creative. In consumer AI, paid social rewards volume and iteration speed more than clever targeting, and you will be shipping a lot of creative against a product that generates images and video. That is an unusual advantage and we want someone who will actually use it.

Own paid acquisition on the web
Own strategy and daily execution across Meta, TikTok and Google
Manage budget at real scale, with responsibility for CAC and payback targets
Build and scale web to web and web to app funnels, including paywall and checkout testing
Make the funnel convert
Run structured CRO on landing pages, paywalls, pricing and onboarding
Own trial to paid conversion alongside product and growth
Build the measurement setup you need, from attribution through to incrementality testing
Ship creative at volume
Work with designers, editors and creators to keep a constant flow of new ad concepts
Build a testing cadence where losing creative is killed fast and winners are scaled
Use ImagineArt itself, and AI tooling generally, to compress the time from idea to live ad
Own the numbers
Report on spend, CAC, payback, LTV and contribution margin honestly, including what is not working
Forecast what more budget would actually buy
Decide where the next dollar goes

Required
You have personally managed $1M+ USD in paid media. Not an agency aggregate across many clients, not a team total. Budget you owned.
Direct experience with consumer subscription economics: CAC, payback window, trial to paid
Hands-on ownership of Meta, TikTok or Google at meaningful daily spend
Web funnel experience. You have built and optimised web checkout or paywall flows, not only app store installs.
You can show your own numbers and explain what you would do differently

Experience in consumer AI, creative tools, or another category where creative volume is the bottleneck
AI tooling already inside your own workflow, not just as a product you market
Experience scaling in more than one market or language
Comfort working across time zones with a distributed team
Not a fit if

s.h: Your experience is mainly B2B lead generation or brand marketing
s.t:
Your spend figure is an agency total rather than budget you owned
You need a large existing team and established processes to be effective
How We'll Assess You
We will ask you one question early, so you may as well know it now: what is the largest monthly budget you personally owned, on a single account, and what was the payback window. Bring real numbers. We would much rather hear about a channel that stopped working and what you did about it than a highlight reel.

Profitable, no outside funding, so the growth is real and so is the budget
A product that makes the creative your ads depend on
Direct access to founders and genuine ownership of the number
Full-time, and we are flexible on location for the right person

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We’re looking for a Solutions Marketing Manager to shape how LangChain brings its full platform to priority industries, enterprise buyers, and high-value use cases.
This role sits at the intersection of product and GTM. You’ll translate customer problems into clear solution narratives, repeatable sales plays, campaign themes, and customer-facing assets that help teams understand where LangChain fits in their AI strategy.
You’ll develop industry solutions, use case solutions, and enterprise solution stories for segments such as financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and other priority markets. You’ll work closely with sales, solutions, product, demand generation, field marketing, education, and customer teams to understand what matters in the field, turn those insights into messaging and collateral, and help create programs that support pipeline and revenue generation.
The role covers the full LangChain platform, including Observability & Evaluation, Deployment, Sandboxes, LLM Gateway, Fleet, Engine, and OSS. The goal is to explain how these products work together to help companies build, deploy, monitor, and improve agents in production.
You’ll define the problems we solve for specific audiences, package those into repeatable narratives, and help GTM teams take them to market.

Develop industry and use case solutions
Build solution narratives for priority industries and enterprise use cases. Initial focus areas include financial services, healthcare, and life sciences, with room to expand based on GTM priorities.
Translate customer problems into clear solution stories. You’ll connect LangChain’s platform capabilities to the business, operational, governance, and technical needs of specific audiences.
Define repeatable use case messaging. You’ll identify where agents can create value across functions and industries, then turn those patterns into solution briefs, use case pages, campaign assets, sales decks, webinar narratives, and customer-facing content.

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.
Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

We're looking for our founding APAC Field Marketing Leader, someone strategy-strong who can autonomously own a regional function end to end — set the strategy, build the operating system, carry the number, and represent marketing credibly to regional sales leadership and to global marketing leadership at the same time. Not a program manager who executes a plan set elsewhere.
The essential tension to screen for: this person needs the seniority and judgment to lead an org, and the willingness to be a team of one for a while. Regional expansion is planned but the timing isn't fixed, which means for some meaningful period they are writing the doc, running the roundtable, and negotiating with the agency themselves. Scrappy, low-ego, and hands-on — but senior enough to see the whole picture without the support systems a mature regional marketing org would provide.
Regional judgment matters more here than in most field marketing roles. One person cannot serve five sub-regions equally, so the job is fundamentally about sequencing: which markets get real first-party investment, which get partner-led coverage, and which wait. They need to make those calls, defend them to sales leaders in each market, and revisit them as signal comes in.
Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.
What a successful candidate looks like: a leader who landed in a new region with nothing, picked the right two markets to prove out, used partner and agency capacity to punch well above their headcount, and can point to the pipeline, the operating system, and the team plan they left behind.
Ideal Profiles
The first-in-region builder who then scaled it. Was the founding field or regional marketing hire for APAC at an enterprise software company and grew it into a team. Brings direct experience with both halves of this job. Pressure-test whether they built a durable function or just ran events, and whether they're still willing to be hands-on at the start.
The partner-led regional leader. Led co-marketing and demand programs through cloud providers, resellers, and distributors across APAC markets. Strongest on leverage and ecosystem motion. Pressure-test whether they can also build direct enterprise ABM and own a pipeline number independent of partners.
The multi-market APAC field marketing leader. Owned field marketing across several APAC sub-regions at a scaled tech company. Brings market fluency, local vendor and event relationships, and cultural range. Pressure-test appetite for building infrastructure from scratch rather than operating within an existing system, and for the period before they have a team.

Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Why this role is on the menu
Media is one of Instacart's most powerful growth levers, and the team is actively evolving its operating model to serve multiple lines of business through a mix of in-house and agency-managed media.

Without strong operating infrastructure, the media team risks spending its time on coordination and manual workarounds rather than strategy, innovation, and campaign performance. This role exists to design, own, and continuously improve the core mechanics of how the media team plans, executes, and optimizes work.

Twelve months from now, the media team will operate with a clear, scalable, and trusted operating system that makes it easy to do great work without reliance on tribal knowledge.

Media's planning frameworks, templates, and cadences are redesigned and adopted across the team, driving clarity and accountability in annual and quarterly planning cycles.

Cross-functional operating rhythms, including business reviews and integrated campaign program management, run with transparent workback schedules, strong stakeholder communication, and consistent follow-through.
Change management for new systems and processes is executed effectively, with documentation, training, and communication plans that drive adoption across media and partner teams.

7 to 10 or more years of experience in Marketing or Media Operations, Program Management, Business Operations, or a closely related field within complex, cross-functional organizations.
Demonstrated experience as a senior individual contributor with real decision authority and ownership over cross-functional operating systems.
Fluency in program management: workback schedules, risk management, project velocity, and hands-on ownership of project management tooling for non-technical teams.
Systems mindset: proven ability to take fragmented or inconsistent processes and make them clearer, simpler, and more reliable, with a track record of building standardized templates and driving adoption across multiple teams.
Strong understanding of how media teams plan, intake, prioritize, and execute work at scale, including familiarity with media tech stacks.
Excellent written communication and structured thinking, with the ability to turn complex inputs into crisp narratives and leadership-ready materials.

Experience driving deep cross-functional partnerships, building alignment, and working with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership.

## Description ##
## Where passion meets opportunity ##

## Your Purpose ##
The Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager is responsible for developing and executing the retail activation strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys, with the objective of increasing guest engagement, driving boutique traffic and supporting commercial performance.
The role creates and manages the onboard retail activation calendar, including events, micro-events, brand animations, VIP experiences and local initiatives designed to enhance the guest journey and maximize retail opportunities.
Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, onboard teams, CRM, Marketing and luxury brand partners, the role transforms retail strategies into memorable experiences that generate customer engagement, conversion and loyalty.

**Retail Activation Strategy**
* Define and manage the global retail activation framework across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.
* Develop an annual activation calendar aligned with commercial priorities, seasonality, itineraries, and guest profiles.
* Create initiatives that drive boutique traffic, customer engagement, and sales performance.
* Balance major events with agile onboard activations.
* Ensure all activations reflect the positioning of each brand.
**Event & Experience Management**
* Develop and execute onboard retail events, including product launches, brand showcases, VIP experiences, collection previews, and seasonal activations.
* Manage event concepts, timelines, logistics, and execution.
* Partner with luxury brands to leverage expertise, ambassadors, and activation resources.
* Measure event performance and implement improvements.
**Traffic Generation & Commercial Activation**
* Develop initiatives that increase boutique visitation and customer engagement.
* Create activation plans around new products, hero items, seasonal moments, itineraries, guest segments, and special occasions.
* Partner with Retail Operations to convert activations into commercial results.
* Introduce innovative approaches to attract diverse guest profiles.
**VIP & Client Engagement**
* Develop VIP engagement strategies with CRM and onboard teams.
* Create personalized retail experiences for high value guests.
* Support clienteling initiatives, including private appointments, exclusive previews, tailored product recommendations, and luxury brand experiences.
* Strengthen guest loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.
**Local & Destination Based Activations**
* Develop activations tailored to destinations, itineraries, and guest profiles.
* Build partnerships with relevant local stakeholders where appropriate.
* Adapt activation strategies to regional opportunities.
* Integrate destination storytelling into retail experiences.
**Brand Partner Collaboration**
* Partner with luxury and premium brands to deliver joint activations and events.
* Manage brand participation and execution standards onboard.
* Ensure alignment between brand objectives and MSC / Explora commercial priorities.
* Coordinate all required brand assets and activation requirements.
**Content & Communication Coordination**
* Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and onboard teams to maximize activation visibility.
* Support the development of invitations, digital communications, onboard announcements, guest messaging, and promotional materials.
* Ensure consistent storytelling across all guest touchpoints.
**Performance Measurement**
* Define and track KPIs including attendance, traffic, sales uplift, conversion, engagement, and VIP participation.
* Analyze results and continuously optimize activation strategies.
* Share best practices and successful initiatives across the fleet.
**Cross Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with the VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training, and onboard leadership teams.
* Ensure retail activations support broader commercial and guest experience objectives.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 7+ years of experience in retail marketing, luxury events, client engagement or experiential marketing.
* Experience within luxury retail, travel retail, hospitality or premium brands.
* Proven experience creating and executing customer engagement initiatives.
* Strong experience managing events, partnerships and commercial activations.
* Experience working with luxury brands and VIP clientele is highly desirable

* Strong understanding of luxury customer experience and experiential retail.
* Excellent project management and event execution skills.
* Strong commercial mindset with ability to link activation to business results.
* Creative thinker with ability to develop engaging concepts.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in an international environment.
* Strong understanding of CRM, clienteling and customer engagement principles.
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .
The Problems You'll Solve
At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Lead Product Marketing Manager focused on GTM enablement, you'll work to:
Bring deep knowledge of private markets finance personas and buying groups (venture capital, private equity, private credit) to how we position, launch, and sustain products — with a specific lens on what resonates in a sales conversation
Develop and maintain high-impact assets including sales decks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, one-pagers, demo narratives, and channel-specific materials that equip AEs and partners to win
Build and execute outbound PMM strategy in close partnership with Sales, translating product capabilities into pipeline-driving narratives and segment-specific messaging
Deploy PMM planning and prioritization in conjunction with the wider marketing team, evaluating what investments — in deliverables and resourcing — are needed to move revenue
Partner with Demand Generation and Integrated Marketing to ensure outbound campaigns reflect product positioning and are built with sales workflow in mind
Enable strong creative execution through high-quality briefs in partnership with Creative and Program Management, with a bias toward assets that perform in the field
Operate cross-functionally across PMM, Creative/Brand, Enablement, Ops, and Sales to align GTM motions from awareness through close
Develop segment and persona-level messaging informed by customer research, competitive intelligence, and direct feedback from the field
Act as a key analytics owner for launch and enablement performance — tracking what's being used, what's converting, and what needs to evolve
Collaborate with Customer Marketing on upsell and cross-sell plays that expand revenue within existing accounts
Influence product development by surfacing structured customer and seller feedback into the product roadmap
Be present in market through owned and external events; represent Carta's product narrative at customer events, internal kickoffs, and industry conferences

You’ll be joining our Marketing team, as part of our Product and Customer Marketing team. Marketing is the engine for growth at Carta. We bring our values to life through our brand, and drive demand for products and services across a complex market landscape. We infuse the customer in everything we design, define and deliver and reflect the inspiration and ambition of our customers in the work we do.

A successful Product Marketing Manager for this role would likely have:
8+ years of hands-on product marketing/GTM experience
Preferably, SaaS fintech experience and/or product marketing experience at companies that serve VC or similar investor types
Motivation to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
Creative problem solving skills
Ability to diagnose problems, isolate them into their component parts, and drive towards creative solutions
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex thoughts and strategies into actionable value propositions for prospects and customers

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes.

We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Product marketing at Celonis is strategic, scrappy, and tight-knit. We value leading with empathy in our interactions, working closely with each other and other teams (often deliberately delivering projects as mini teams or co-leads of two), giving back together, and making things as simple as possible. Each product marketer is the CMO of their product domain and focused on four pillars:
Defining and executing product positioning, messaging, and launches
Enabling and supporting the go-to-market and marketing teams
Informing product strategy
Driving product adoption and success.

We’re looking for someone who loves technology and products, and knows how to turn complex ideas into clear, compelling stories. You’ll own our CIO narrative and offering, while also working with Corporate Development & Partnerships on strategic technology partners including OpenAI, Microsoft, and Oracle.
Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Marketing for Platform, you’ll work closely with Product, Customer Transformation, Sales, Presales, Marketing, and our partners to shape positioning, joint value propositions, and go-to-market strategy.

Product Positioning
Create product positioning and messaging for global scalability, differentiating our product within the market.
Craft compelling pitch decks, demos, keynotes, and event sessions tailored to the target audience.
Be the go-to expert on how our product showcases the capabilities of the Celonis platform.
Market Mastery
Utilize sales engagement, market research, and competitive intelligence to dominate the product area market.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and execute effective go-to-market strategies.
Inform Product Strategy
Partner with the product management team to strategize and launch new products, ensuring ongoing adoption.
Develop a deep understanding of buyer behaviors, criteria, and influencers to inform product strategies
Product Adoption and Success
Understand the product's value proposition and competition, coaching teams on outmaneuvering rivals.
Work closely with the demand generation team to develop impactful campaigns driving pipeline growth.
Collaborate with the content marketing team to produce compelling materials such as solution briefs, white papers, blogs, videos, and third-party articles.
Establish thought leadership by participating in events, social media, press, and industry analyst engagements.

8+ years of experience across software product management, presales, consulting, product marketing, or a related field
Strong expertise in data, AI, automation, or enterprise technology
Track record of launching products, partnerships, or joint solutions with strategic technology partners
Comfortable with technical concepts and engaging CIOs and other senior IT and business leaders on their priorities
Strong presenter, with experience at customer engagements, executive briefings, and industry events
Highly analytical, with an ability to connect technical capabilities to customer and market needs
Proactive and comfortable owning multiple workstreams end to end
Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to give and receive feedback and change direction quickly
Bias for action, with a consistent track record of delivering measurable results
BA/BS degree or equivalent experience; technical or quantitative background is a plus.

Datadog is seeking a Partner Marketing Manager, India to build and lead our go-to-market strategy with key partners across the India region. You will join a growing APJ partner marketing organization — currently made up of an APJ lead based in Singapore and individual contributor managers covering ANZ, ASEAN, Korea, and Tokyo — and play a critical role in scaling Datadog's presence in one of our most strategic growth markets.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Own and develop a go-to-market strategy with Datadog's key channel and cloud partners across India, tailored to the region's partner ecosystem and business priorities
Collaborate closely with the APJ lead, the broader APJ marketing team, and the global partner marketing team to align India's strategy with regional and global priorities
Partner with Channels & Alliances sales to identify the highest-impact partners and design joint marketing programs that drive pipeline generation and net-new customer acquisition

Build strong stakeholder relationships across sales, partner, and marketing teams, creating channels for bi-directional feedback that shapes ongoing strategy, programs, and campaigns
Communicate strategy, results, and recommendations clearly to both internal stakeholders and external partners
Track and report on the performance of partner marketing programs, using data and insights to continuously refine the regional approach
Stay close to the India (and broader ROA) partner landscape, bringing market knowledge back into strategy and planning discussions

Proven track record of driving strategy and executing regional partner campaigns with measurable results
Strong communicator, able to clearly convey strategy, results, and recommendations to both internal and external stakeholders
Experience working across cross-functional and cross-regional teams, with the ability to ensure alignment and drive shared outcomes

Intellectually curious, with genuine excitement for building and shaping partner marketing strategy

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions.

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.

Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

In this role, you are responsible for executing regional marketing strategy and independently leading programs that drive measurable business outcomes. Working within regional priorities, you are trusted to make decisions, adapt plans as conditions change, and take ownership of program performance from planning through results.
Approximately 50% of your work is self-directed, requiring sound judgment, strong prioritization, and accountability for outcomes. Success in this role comes from balancing execution with strategic thinking, identifying opportunities for improvement, and sharing best practices that increase team effectiveness.
You are expected to leverage AI as a core part of your work, applying it thoughtfully to improve productivity, scale repeatable processes, and enhance decision-making. This includes identifying where AI can create efficiencies, where human judgment remains essential, and developing workflows that can be adopted across the team.

s.h: What makes you a Great Fit
s.t:
Lead regional marketing programs from planning through execution and retrospective, including program strategy, budget management, goal setting, delivery, and performance reporting.
Execute ABM and regional marketing initiatives, partnering closely with Sales and SDR teams while contributing to prioritization and program planning.
Independently manage day-to-day decisions, proactively address risks, and escalate issues when appropriate.
Serve as a proficient user of core marketing platforms, including Splash, Zuddl, Salesforce, and Monday.com, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and tooling.
Develop and document AI-enabled workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across marketing operations, event execution, and reporting.
Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation across regional marketing programs and contribute to the development of shared team processes and best practices.
Analyze program performance and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Plan and manage projects independently, set realistic timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver on commitments.
Provide guidance and support to Associates, contractors, and other team members on shared initiatives.
Build expertise in Grafana's go-to-market strategy, regional marketing programs, and the ecosystem of channels, vendors, and partners that support growth.

s.h: What you'll bring at this level
s.t:
Located on the West Coast of the United States
3-5 years in field or regional marketing, or events, including end-to-end ownership of programs
Strong project, time, and stakeholder management, with consistent attention to detail
Independent proficiency with Splash, Zuddl, Salesforce, and Monday.com or similar
Demonstrated experience operationalizing AI in marketing work: reusable prompts, documented processes, or lightweight automations
Open source go-to-market motion and the regional market a plus
Willingness to travel approximately 40%

The program you own runs cleanly, from start to finish, and hits its goals.
You keep moving as priorities shift, without direction at each step.
Problems get caught and handled before a customer ever feels them.
Your reporting leaves people with a story and a lesson, not just numbers.
The AI workflows you build get picked up by others, so the team produces more without adding headcount.
You find and close process gaps, and the junior teammates you guide do better work for it.

We’re looking for a Senior Ads Product Marketing Manager to shape the future of performance bidding, optimization, and measurement at Pinterest. You’ll own the go-to-market strategy for new solutions that help advertisers align campaign delivery with the business outcomes they value most.
In this role, you’ll translate complex advertiser measurement needs into clear product strategy, positioning, and scalable go-to-market motions.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Measurement, Sales, Performance Solutions, and Product Operations to bring new lower-funnel solutions from early testing through broader adoption.

Your work will help advertisers optimize toward the outcomes that matter in their own measurement source of truth—and build greater confidence in Pinterest as a performance channel.

Own product marketing strategy and go-to-market execution for Pinterest’s measurement-aligned bidding and optimization portfolio, including MPO, Last Click Mode/optimization windows, and future custom conversion solutions.
Build a deep understanding of advertiser measurement approaches, attribution models, lower-funnel objectives, and performance needs to identify high-value market opportunities and influence product strategy.
Define target segments, customer problems, value propositions, positioning, messaging, and proof points for early-stage and scaled bidding products.
Lead commercialization for alpha and beta programs: shape learning agendas, define advertiser eligibility and recruitment strategies, develop onboarding and enablement materials, and turn findings into product and GTM recommendations.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Measurement teams to translate market insights into product requirements, prioritize investments, and navigate technical and commercial tradeoffs.
Serve as the voice of advertisers and Sales to Product, and the voice of Product to Sales—synthesizing customer feedback, competitive intelligence, product data, and opportunity sizing into decision-ready recommendations.
Develop clear narratives, sales enablement, training, and customer-facing materials that make complex bidding, optimization, and measurement concepts accessible and actionable.
Establish success metrics across adoption, advertiser performance, sentiment, revenue impact, and operational readiness; use results to refine product strategy and determine the path from alpha to beta to broader scale.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Sales, Performance Solutions, Measurement Solutions, Product Operations, Business Marketing, Legal, and other partners to deliver cohesive, scalable product launches.
Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate market research, customer-feedback synthesis, and analysis, while applying sound judgment, validating outputs, and maintaining ownership of final recommendations.

5+ years of product marketing, ads marketing, or related experience, ideally in performance advertising, ad delivery, bidding, measurement, attribution, or marketing technology.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience developing and executing product go-to-market strategies, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, enablement, launch planning, and adoption measurement.
Experience bringing early-stage products or features through alpha, beta, and broader commercialization; comfort operating when product-market fit, product scope, and operating models are still evolving.
Strong understanding of lower-funnel advertising, conversion optimization, CPA/ROAS, attribution, and first- and third-party measurement approaches.
Technical fluency to understand and communicate how conversion signals, data integrations, attribution windows, optimization models, and bidding strategies affect advertiser outcomes.
Strong analytical judgment and experience using qualitative and quantitative data to define customer needs, size opportunities, evaluate test outcomes, and make strategic recommendations.
Proven ability to influence and build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Solutions, Operations, and executive stakeholders.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for internal and external audiences.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, or workflow efficiency while validating accuracy, protecting sensitive information, and retaining ownership of final work.

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We are hiring our first partner marketer for ElevenAgents in North America. We are looking for someone who has built partner marketing programs at scale and knows what it looks like when it is done well.
ElevenAgents is already inside some of the world’s largest enterprises. The ecosystem is ready to move. The hyperscalers, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft, are where a growing share of enterprise software now gets bought. The global and regional systems integrators are the firms actually delivering these deployments. What we do not have yet is anyone marketing that.
One week you are running a joint go-to-market program at an industry event with a technology partner, drawing on a shared MDF budget. The next you are working with a systems integrator to get ElevenAgents in front of the right enterprise buyers. You will define what partner marketing looks like at ElevenLabs, then build it: the programs, the playbooks, and the relationships.
The goal is to 11x the return we get from our partner relationships.

You have built partner marketing programs from scratch and know what 0 to 1 actually looks like in practice.
You have hands-on experience across co-marketing: joint campaigns, co-branded events, MDF management, and partner enablement.
You have run at least one hyperscaler or systems integrator relationship yourself, and can name it.
You know the mechanics. Cloud marketplaces, co-sell programs, MDF, partner tiers, and practice enablement. You can explain how the money moves and who has to say yes.
You understand what technology and SI partners need to go to market effectively, and how to make it easy for them to say yes.
You can build partner relationships on both sides of the table and earn trust quickly.
You know how to measure partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and can translate that into something meaningful for leadership.
You set your own priorities and move without waiting to be asked.
You have 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 3 to 5 years in partner or channel marketing.
Bonus
Experience marketing AI agents, contact center technology, or developer tooling.
Experience launching a product into a category that did not exist yet.
Growth Potential
We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth.
Build the partner motion from 0 to 1, then build the team around it. North America is our largest market and this function will grow with it.
Go deep on the ecosystem and own alliances marketing across all three ElevenLabs platforms.
For those who want to go broader, there is a path to a B2B marketing leadership role as ElevenLabs scales in North America.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America with the ability to operate in PT or ET timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.
If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.
*Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco or San Jose office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.
An ML team spins up an on-demand instance to prototype, outgrows it within a month, and needs a 512-GPU cluster with managed Slurm before their next training run. This role owns how Lambda meets them at every step: how the Public Cloud portfolio is positioned, packaged, launched, and enabled across self-service and sales-assisted motions.
Lambda Cloud is a unified public cloud purpose-built and performance-optimized for AI workloads. The portfolio spans on-demand and reserved GPU instances, 1-Click Clusters, managed Kubernetes and Slurm, and supporting storage, networking, and platform capabilities. It serves customers ranging from AI-native startups and ML teams to enterprises and frontier labs.
We're hiring a technical product marketing manager to own product marketing for the Public Cloud portfolio. You'll define how the portfolio is positioned, packaged, launched, and enabled across self-service and sales-assisted motions, working daily with product management, engineering, sales, solutions engineering, enablement, finance, and marketing. Product management owns product truth. You translate that truth into positioning, use cases, launches, and content that drive adoption and revenue.
This role requires infrastructure depth. You can explain how GPU architecture, interconnect, storage throughput, data movement, orchestration, reliability, and cloud consumption models affect distributed training and inference. You can also communicate those tradeoffs to ML engineers, Enterprise architects, sales teams, and executive buyers.

Own Public Cloud product marketing. Define and maintain positioning, messaging, audience segmentation, and the use-case library across the portfolio. Serve as the primary product marketing partner to the Public Cloud business unit, working with product management on roadmap context, packaging, and launch planning.
Build use cases and the portfolio GTM architecture. Translate training, fine-tuning, inference, and proof-of-concept workloads into documented, sellable use cases mapped to segment and infrastructure requirements. Establish how customers progress from on-demand evaluation to 1-Click Clusters and managed services. Clarify which offering fits each workload, segment, operational model, cluster size, and commercial commitment.
Execute product launches. Own launch execution for new product features, instance types, APIs, and managed services. Partner with product management and engineering from roadmap planning through general availability, including launch, audience definition, positioning, technical validation, content, field readiness, and post-launch analysis.
Create product-focused technical content. Produce messaging and positioning, solution briefs, datasheets, benchmark narratives, technical blogs, reference architectures, API and CLI walkthroughs, and use cases. Validate every technical claim with Product Management and Engineering.
Support sales and solutions engineering. Build discovery frameworks, qualification guidance, pitch materials, proposal content, battlecards, technical training, and competitive displacement narratives. Support active opportunities with workload- and segment-specific positioning.
Enable the broader marketing organization. Equip demand generation, growth, content, events, web, communications, and customer marketing with approved messaging, use cases, audience guidance, technical proof points, and launch materials. Review downstream content for consistency and technical accuracy.
You
7+ years of product marketing, technical marketing, product management, or related experience in cloud infrastructure, IaaS, managed services, or adjacent developer platforms
Demonstrated ownership of a technical product portfolio, including positioning, use-case development, product launches, competitive strategy, field enablement, and adoption
Deep working knowledge of AI infrastructure, with the ability to independently reason about GPU architectures, bare metal and virtualized compute, multi-node cluster topology, InfiniBand and RDMA fabrics, Ethernet networking, storage and data movement, Kubernetes and Slurm, APIs, observability, reliability, and cloud security
Demonstrated ability to produce technical content (benchmarks, whitepapers, architecture guides, datasheets, solution briefs, and technical demos) that withstands review by engineering audiences
Strong written and verbal communication across technical and GTM audiences, from engineers and infrastructure architects to sales leadership and executive buyers

Hands-on experience deploying AI or HPC workloads using a cloud console, API, CLI, Kubernetes, or Slurm
Familiarity with CUDA, PyTorch, NCCL, distributed training frameworks, and benchmarking methodologies such as MLPerf
Experience marketing managed Kubernetes, managed Slurm, GPU cloud infrastructure, or MLOps offerings
Previous experience as a product manager, solutions architect, infrastructure engineer, developer advocate, or technical sales engineer

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.
As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Synthesia is the #1 Enterprise AI video generation since 2016, and today we work with 90% of the Fortune 100. Our core product, Studio, lets anyone turn a script into a polished video with an AI avatar, no camera or crew required.
Now we're entering a new chapter, and the API is at the center of it. Our Interactive Avatar API lets any company build real-time, conversational avatars directly into their own products.
You're the first product marketing hire dedicated to the API, and you'll build the GTM motion from scratch.
There's no playbook here yet. You'll set the foundational positioning, write the developer-facing messaging, stand up the launch process, and figure out how we reach developers and win them.

You get energy from building from scratch, and have a hacker mentality.
You use gen AI video tools and created content with them. You're in every new model the week it drops.
You've built with APIs yourself: called endpoints, read the code samples, wired up a webhook, shipped something small. You know how developers actually integrate and ship.
You've done product marketing, growth, or developer marketing for enterprise audiences.
You're an excellent communicator, written and spoken. You have experience managing senior stakeholders and complex program management.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
Vanta's Product Marketing team sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. We define positioning and narrative for Vanta's platform, translate roadmap into go-to-market motions across big launch moments and releases, and make sure the field can sell what Product is building; with research, storytelling, and cross-functional partnership as the core of how we work.

AI is one of Vanta's most strategic bets, and it needs a dedicated owner. This PMM will be focused on bringing the AI roadmap to market in close partnership with EPD. You'll own the narrative, messaging, and positioning for Vanta’s AI story end-to-end, and be the connective tissue between what Engineering and Product are building and how the market, field, and customers understand it.
You're expected to shape our AI story and define Vanta as a leader in the space, which means you’re fast-moving and nimble, have enough technical fluency to have a real point of view in roadmap conversations with EPD (including getting hands-on and testing the product yourself), paired with the storytelling and creativity to bring a unique, differentiated story to market.

Own the AI pillar narrative and roadmap end to end
Own the AI pillar narrative at key events like VantaCon, including keynote support, breakout sessions, and customer testimonials
Ensure a cohesive AI narrative across pillars so AI messaging holds together whether it's showing up in Compliance, Risk, or Proof contexts
Partner directly with EPD to understand what's being built, influence roadmap sequencing from a market/customer lens, and translate technical capability into external-ready narrative
Develop and maintain AI messaging and positioning that flexes across audiences (field, analysts, press, customers)
Drive field enablement for AI, arming Sales and CS with the story, objection handling, and proof points they need
Plan and execute AI product launches, from planning through post-launch measurement
Represent the AI narrative in customer-facing and market-facing moments (analyst briefings, customer advisory conversations, press as needed)

s.t:
Core PMM experience
7+ years in product marketing, ideally with ownership of a full pillar or product line rather than a support function
Track record of building narrative and positioning from scratch, not just executing an existing playbook
Experience partnering directly with Product/Engineering leadership
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Plan and execute large product launches (including partnership with comms to align on product narrative), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation.

Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.
