Role Description
Dropbox is hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager, AI & ISV Ecosystem to help define how Dropbox shows up in the next generation of AI-powered work. As AI and productivity platforms rapidly reshape how people create, access, and collaborate around content, this role will lead some of Dropbox’s most important ecosystem marketing opportunities.

You will develop joint go-to-market strategies and high-impact programs with strategic technology partners—including OpenAI, Anthropic , and other leading AI and productivity platforms—while unlocking new growth opportunities across Dropbox’s broader integration ecosystem.
You will lead and develop a small team of partner marketers, operating as a true player-coach: setting direction, prioritizing the biggest opportunities, creating the conditions for your team to do their best work, and helping them grow as strategic marketers, while also contributing to hands-on execution.

You will also serve as a senior marketing partner across Business Development, Partnerships, Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Communications, turning technical integrations and partnership opportunities into compelling customer stories, differentiated value propositions, and integrated programs that drive adoption, awareness, pipeline, and growth.
This role owns partner-specific go-to-market strategy, joint positioning, integrated activation, evergreen co-marketing, and performance optimization for Dropbox’s priority AI and ISV relationships; partner selection, commercial agreements, product-roadmap decisions, sales execution, and partner-systems administration remain owned by the corresponding Business Development, Product, Sales, and Operations teams.
This role is designed for a strategic builder, creative marketer, and people leader who thrives where technology, partnerships, and go-to-market intersect. You will identify where Dropbox can create disproportionate value across the ecosystem, shape joint strategies with influential external partners, and lead complex initiatives from early opportunity through launch, activation, measurement, and scale.
You will join Dropbox at a pivotal moment as AI changes how people interact with their content and where work gets done. This is an opportunity to help shape Dropbox’s position in the emerging AI ecosystem, work alongside some of the world’s most influential technology companies, build a high-impact team, and create the partner marketing models that will help define Dropbox’s next phase of growth.
AI is already embedded in this workflow. You will use approved AI tools to accelerate partner research, insight synthesis, campaign ideation, content development, launch planning, and performance analysis—and you will help build better AI-enabled workflows for the team while maintaining rigorous human judgment, review, and accountability.

Set the strategy and build the roadmap : Closely partner with Business Development to define the partner strategy, and own Dropbox’s partner marketing strategy across priority AI and ISV partners, translate business and customer priorities into a clear portfolio of bets, and create the roadmap, prioritization criteria, and operating approach needed to execute against them.
Personally build and execute high-priority programs : Lead the most strategic and complex partner marketing initiatives from concept through launch and optimization, including developing joint value propositions, campaign briefs, go-to-market plans, content strategies, activation plans, and partner-facing deliverables—not simply directing the work from a distance.

This manager personally leads programs that are highly ambiguous, executive-visible, or strategically consequential, while direct reports own defined partner programs end to end.
Create an evergreen co-marketing engine: Build repeatable programs that extend strategic partnerships beyond launch moments, including joint campaigns, customer stories, lifecycle activation, events, content, partner amplification, and other motions that drive sustained awareness, adoption, engagement, pipeline, and revenue objectives.
Turn strategy into scalable operating mechanisms: Design and implement partner segmentation, reusable launch frameworks and templates, decision rights, operating cadences, measurement approaches, campaign governance, and joint investment planning that help the team move faster and scale successful programs across the ecosystem.
Lead partners and cross-functional execution: Build trusted relationships with strategic partners and work hands-on with Partnerships, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, make tradeoffs, and drive complex programs to completion.
Lead, coach, and work alongside the team: Manage and develop partner marketers while remaining close enough to the work to unblock execution, raise the quality bar, coach through difficult partner situations, model strong craft, and step directly into priority programs when senior-level ownership is needed.
Build AI-enabled ways of working: Use approved AI tools directly in partner research, synthesis, planning, content development, personalization, and analysis; identify and implement repeatable AI-enabled workflows for the team; and maintain clear human review and accountability for strategy, quality, partner commitments, and business outcomes.

B2B marketing experience: 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in partner, ecosystem, platform, or strategic alliances marketing, with demonstrated ability to set strategy and then personally build the plans, programs, processes, and deliverables required to execute it.
Deep partner marketing craft: Demonstrated experience developing joint value propositions, go-to-market strategies, integrated campaigns, launch plans, and evergreen co-marketing programs with technology, SaaS, platform, AI, or ISV partners.
Strong execution under ambiguity: Proven ability to take an underdefined opportunity, create structure, determine what needs to be built, and drive work from initial concept through execution, measurement, iteration, and scale.
Analytical and data-informed decision-making: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize performance data, customer and partner insights, market signals, and qualitative inputs to evaluate opportunities, diagnose performance, make prioritization decisions, and determine what to scale, change, or stop.
Exceptional writing, messaging, and communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop, translate, and critically review joint messaging with partners; distill complex product and ecosystem concepts into clear customer value propositions; and communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, and decisions effectively to senior internal and external stakeholders.
Cross-functional influence and player-coach leadership: Experience building trust and driving decisions across partners, Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing while managing and developing high-performing marketers, raising the quality bar, and stepping directly into complex work when senior ownership is needed.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Faire is building an AI-enabled talent organization, hiring the people shaping the future of personalized commerce for retailers and brands around the world. We're looking for a Talent Brand Manager to build our employer value proposition and turn it into one cohesive talent brand strategy across all of our digital surfaces: LinkedIn, our careers site, social, Glassdoor, and increasingly, the AI tools candidates now use to research and compare offers.
This is a hands-on, builder role. You'll shape Faire's EVP, then build the systems that carry it to our employees, like building AI tools that make it easy for employees to tell their own stories and put our leaders' voices in front of candidates.

You will also develop an AEO strategy that ensures Faire shows up as the clear, authentic answer when candidates ask LLMs to learn more about the company and compare offers. You'll give recruiters that same enablement, arming them with the narrative and objection-handling they need to authentically represent Faire in the market.
You'll report to Jenny Talwar, Head of Talent, and be based in San Francisco.

Architect our employer value proposition: Define a compelling "why Faire, why now" narrative tailored for key hiring areas, beginning with our Engineering, Product, Design, and Data teams. Highlighting the broad range of backgrounds of the retailers and brands we serve, so the workforce we build increasingly reflects the diversity and vibrancy of our customers.
Create a unified digital footprint: Orchestrate high-impact campaigns across LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and our careers site to ensure a consistent talent brand backed by measurable performance indicators.
Establish Answer Engine Optimization: Develop an AEO framework to ensure Faire’s culture and opportunities are accurately and prominently represented within LLMs.
Champion the talent brand identity: Act as a steward for our voice, ensuring every job description and candidate touchpoint aligns perfectly with Faire’s established brand guidelines.
Scalable storytelling: Establish a repeatable engine for surfacing authentic stories from our leaders and employees that showcase our values, incredible internal mobility stories, and give a real glimpse into life at Faire.
Empower the front line: Create a comprehensive self-serve toolkit for recruiters and hiring managers, including audience-specific positioning and narrative-driven objection handling.
Build AI-powered enablers: Launch internal tools that leverage AI to help every Faire employee transform their personal experiences into polished, social-ready content.
Measure and iterate: Rigorously track candidate sentiment and conversion data to evaluate the effectiveness of our talent brand investments on hiring success.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Marketing and Comms partners to ensure a seamless integration of our employer brand across the business.

5+ years building employer brand, talent marketing, or recruitment marketing programs, ideally from the ground up
Experience running a cohesive brand strategy across owned and earned digital channels: careers site, LinkedIn, social, and Glassdoor
Comfortable building self-serve, custom AI tools for individual and team use, and applying them to drive productivity and scale
Understands how AI-driven search and answer engines (AEO/GEO) shape how a brand's content surfaces, and wants to build that muscle for talent brand
Exceptional writer and editor, able to turn complex, cross-functional work into a story people remember
Experience building recruiter enablement materials, including objection-handling content
Uses data (candidate feedback, funnel metrics, brand perception) to prioritize what to build and prove it worked
Strong cross-functional partner, with experience working across Recruiting, Marketing, Comms, and People teams to ship projects

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara's Connected Operations platform helps organizations that depend on physical operations — fleets, construction, utilities, public works, and first responders — run safer, more efficiently, and more sustainably.
We're looking for a Group Manager, Product Marketing Manager, Public Sector to own the narrative, positioning, and enablement that will define how Samsara wins in government. You'll be the team's expert on how public sector buyers evaluate technology — from the contract vehicles they procure through, to the compliance bar they hold vendors to, to the mission outcomes they're ultimately accountable for.
This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who already understands government and frameworks like FedRAMP and StateRAMP/GovRAMP. The ideal candidate is someone who wants to build a public sector product marketing motion, not just execute inside one that already exists.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in the U.S. We prefer candidates based in or near Washington, D.C., or those able to work Eastern time zone hours.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will have real-world stakes — helping public agencies keep roads plowed, fleets safe, and essential services running for the communities they serve.
You're fluent in how the government buys technology: You understand procurement cycles, contract vehicles, and compliance frameworks well enough to turn them into a go-to-market advantage rather than a blocker.
You're energized by building, not just executing: Samsara's federal go-to-market motion is still being defined — you'll have real ownership over the frameworks, positioning, and playbooks that shape it.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You'll be surrounded by a high-caliber team that pushes you to do your best work.

This is a unique opportunity to do high-impact, executional work on one of the world’s most beloved and innovative brands, reaching millions of learners worldwide.
🧠 You will...
Own day-to-day execution of global performance marketing campaigns, including setting the creative strategy, with a primary focus on mobile user acquisition and growth.
Strategically run and optimize mobile install campaigns across major platforms, such as Google UAC, Meta. Tiktok, and programmatic partners, focusing on high LTV/CAC, efficient spend, and sustainable global growth.
Manage and hold accountable Duolingo’s performance marketing agency partners, ensuring alignment on goals, pacing, and quality of execution.
Leverage deep, data-driven insights to guide decisions, constantly improving key KPIs like CPI, retention, and monetization metrics.
Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across Marketing Analytics, Creative, Engineering, and Finance to align efforts and maximize impact.
Champion a culture of experimentation, continuously testing new channels, creative approaches, and optimization strategies to unlock new growth opportunities.
Develop and present strategic recommendations to marketing leadership, translating campaign performance into actionable insights and proposals.
✅ You have...
Experience running large-scale, global mobile acquisition campaigns.
Strong analytical skills, with expertise in mobile attribution and marketing analytics.
A successful track record of owning and optimizing large performance marketing budgets with direct, hands-on execution.
Deep knowledge of the mobile user acquisition ecosystem, including platforms, attribution technologies, industry trends, and best practices.
Exceptional ability to translate data into strategy and clearly communicate findings to stakeholders at all levels.
Experience working with and managing agency partners to deliver against performance targets.
⭐ Exceptional candidates will have...
Experience in running performance marketing for a top subscription-based mobile app.
Familiarity with incremental measurement methodologies (e.g., geo-lift, incrementality testing, media mix modeling).
A passion about Duolingo’s mission to make education universally accessible.

* Support the preparation of brief for the marketing activations in the ON and OFF premise trade channels and follow up with the agencies.
* Support the execution of brand activities (POS material, Value-Added-Packs) and brand events (portfolio events, brand owned events as well as partner events) for the ON and OFF premise
* Present and represent the brand(s) and brand activities towards clients, journalists and external partners

* Update marketing support files (product catalogues, Value-Added-Packs and Point-Of-Sale (POS) material lists)

* Execute and manage administrative tasks (Purchase Orders, invoices, creation of supplier accounts and product articles)

* Order material for PR events
* Support the Senior Brand Manager and external PR agency with organisational tasks before and during the events
**Press**
* Order material and products for press requests and needs
* Collect input for journalist requests and organizing press trips
* Run image & press text research on our Moët Hennessy libraries
* Prepare clipping summaries for small and large brand related projects and events
* Organise meetings between brand managers and the PR agency
* In charge of ad-hoc tracking reports and activities (shipments to journalists, celebrities and influencers)
**Business Reviews & Analyses**
* Support Brand Manager in preparation of presentation slides for Business Reviews
* Follow up on market and consumer insights data and develop the necessary analyses in order to gain business acumen.
* Support in accounting processes, budget management, approval flow, vendor processes.
**Team Coordination**
* Taking care of general coordination topics in between the marketing team, such as organizing meetings, aligning calendars etc.
**Executive & Administrative Support**
* Provide administrative assistance, including: Calendar and meeting management, international and domestic travel planning, expense reports and approval workflows
* Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes, and follow up on action items.
**Profile**

* You have a bachelor-s degree in international marketing, communication or business
* You have good knowledge and passion for the gastronomy and/or wine & spirits industry
* You are organized & rigorous, with a hands-on-mentality and a pro-active mindset
* You are flexible, responsive to change and able to meet tight deadlines

* German
* English
* French is a plus

You are a team player, energetic, trustworthy with excellent presentation and communication skills, and ready to learn!

Senior Marketing Manager, Global Marketing – Oncology (LUMAKRAS)

Let's do this. Let's change the world.
In this vital role, the Senior Marketing Manager, Global Marketing will be a key member of the Global Oncology Marketing team supporting LUMAKRAS during an important period of brand evolution and launch preparation.
This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape global strategy for two anticipated first line launches in NSCLC and metastatic colorectal cancer, each presenting distinct strategic and commercial challenges. The successful candidate will help determine how LUMAKRAS can compete in an increasingly dynamic NSCLC market while also addressing treatment practice and behavior barriers that may affect adoption in CRC.
Reporting to the Global Marketing Director, this individual will have meaningful strategic responsibility across both first line indications, leading global marketing workstreams that translate market, customer, competitive, and clinical insights into clear strategic choices and launch plans. The role will provide broad exposure to global brand strategy, launch planning, lifecycle management, competitive strategy, and cross functional leadership.
The Senior Marketing Manager will also play an important role in connecting strategy to execution across the organization. This includes managing key Integrated Brand Team and Brand Working Group forums, partnering with regional and affiliate teams to incorporate market perspectives into global strategy and launch preparation, and ensuring decisions and plans are translated into coordinated action.
As clinical evidence, competitive dynamics, and customer insights evolve, this individual will help continuously refine the brand strategy and associated global deliverables to ensure LUMAKRAS remains responsive to a changing treatment landscape.

The responsibilities below represent key focus areas of the role and are not intended to be exhaustive. As business needs evolve, the successful candidate will demonstrate flexibility and agility by taking on additional responsibilities and leading new initiatives that support the needs of the organization.
Global Brand Strategy and Strategic Planning
Lead global marketing workstreams supporting development, refinement, and execution of the LUMAKRAS global brand strategy across NSCLC and CRC.
Translate customer, market, competitive, clinical, and affiliate insights into clear strategic implications, choices, and recommendations for the brand.
Partner with the Global Marketing Director and cross functional stakeholders to identify emerging opportunities, challenges, and strategic considerations across the LUMAKRAS lifecycle.
Continuously assess assumptions underlying the brand strategy and recommend adjustments as the treatment landscape, evidence base, customer behaviors, and competitive environment evolve.
Help define where and how LUMAKRAS can create differentiated value across indications and markets, connecting strategic choices to measurable business objectives.
First Line Launch Strategy and Readiness
Support global launch strategy and readiness workstreams across anticipated first line NSCLC and CRC indications.
Help shape strategies that address the distinct adoption challenges of each market, including increasing competitive intensity in NSCLC and treatment practice and behavior barriers that may affect adoption in CRC.
Translate launch strategy into clear critical success factors, key decisions, risks, mitigation plans, and global deliverables.
Partner across Marketing, Medical, Value & Access, Commercial Excellence, Regions, and Affiliates to integrate functional and market perspectives into global launch planning.
Support global to local launch readiness by ensuring markets have the strategic direction, insights, resources, and global guidance needed to develop locally relevant launch plans.
Capture and apply launch learnings across markets to continuously strengthen global strategy and execution.
Market, Customer, and Competitive Strategy
Maintain a strong understanding of evolving NSCLC and CRC treatment landscapes, customer behaviors, competitive developments, and market dynamics and assess their implications for LUMAKRAS strategy.
Partner with Competitive Intelligence, Commercial Data and Analytics, Medical, regional teams, and affiliates to identify emerging developments that could materially affect launch strategy, positioning, or execution.
Translate insights into strategic recommendations, scenarios, and potential responses that enable the organization to anticipate changes in the market.
Lead or support strategic workshops, market working sessions, and scenario planning designed to pressure test assumptions and strengthen brand and launch strategy.
Positioning and Messaging Evolution
Lead or support evolution of LUMAKRAS positioning strategy and messaging as clinical evidence, competitive profiles, customer insights, and market dynamics evolve.
Ensure messaging remains grounded in approved evidence and aligned with the broader brand strategy and intended customer behavior change.
Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Legal, and other appropriate stakeholders to develop and refine global communication frameworks and resources.
Ensure changes to positioning and messaging are informed by clear strategic rationale rather than developed as standalone communication exercises.
Global to Local Strategy and Affiliate Partnership
Build strong partnerships with regional and affiliate marketing teams to incorporate relevant market perspectives and insights into global strategy and launch planning.
Manage LUMAKRAS Integrated Brand Team and Brand Working Group meetings, including meeting planning, agenda development, coordination of strategic discussions, and follow through on decisions and actions.
Facilitate alignment, sharing of launch learnings, and exchange of best practices across functions and markets.

Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business.
As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables.

You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist.

You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger.
It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline.
You'll have real authority to change what isn't working from day one, and on a team this size, a fix you make on Tuesday can be live by Friday. By the end of the year, you'll be the person leadership trusts for a straight answer on whether campaigns and events are actually working.

Translate GTM priorities, ICP definitions, and quarterly pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid, events, and email, then build and ship them yourself.
Own paid media end to end, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube while partnering with our agency on execution.
Drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables, sharpening targeting and follow-through while focusing investment on what delivers results.
Carry a quarterly qualified-pipeline number and defend coverage, quality, and conversion with sales leadership, not just volume.
Architect HubSpot as an owner, managing workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign objects, and the Salesforce sync.
Build and defend the metrics that matter, including CPL, cost per qualified opportunity, event-sourced pipeline, and multi-touch attribution.
Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps internally, and agencies, venues, and sponsors externally, to run multiple concurrent campaigns and events without dropping a thread.

A track record of hands-on HubSpot ownership, having personally architected and administered an instance, including workflows, lifecycle, scoring, campaigns, and the Salesforce sync.
Direct paid media execution, with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and pacing campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, not just briefing an agency.
Salesforce fluency, with the ability to navigate objects, fields, and reports and reason about how marketing data lands in the CRM and why it breaks.
B2B SaaS demand generation experience, ideally within a considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycle.
Experience owning event strategy and execution, including trade shows, webinars, and executive-level programs like roundtables or dinners.
Comfort owning a function end to end, balancing strategy with hands-on execution in an individual contributor role.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to effectively manage internal stakeholders and external vendors and partners.

Experience in privacy, data governance, security, compliance, or another regulated, technical software category.
Marketo or Pardot experience alongside HubSpot.
Familiarity with account-based marketing or intent-data tools.
Comfort using AI to speed up operational work, such as campaign QA, data hygiene, or reporting synthesis.
Experience being the first or founding owner of a demand gen or marketing ops function, from the ground up with hands-on responsibility for building and scaling it.
What Success Looks Like

Learn DataGrail's product, buyer personas, and ICP quickly enough to start contributing, not just observing, and meet the marketing, sales, RevOps, and customer success teams to understand what's running and where the friction is.
Take full ownership of the paid channels and the agency relationship, and identify specific over- or under-spending by channel.
Drive the event calendar and process, and produce a keep, fix, or cut recommendation for each program.
Audit HubSpot and existing reporting, and deliver a written list of what's fragile, missing, or misleading in current attribution and lifecycle reporting.
Ship at least one visible fix to a live, underperforming channel or process

Show measurable improvement, with before and after comparisons, on two to three of the biggest inefficiencies identified in the 90-day audit, whether that's rebalanced paid spend, improved event-to-pipeline conversion, or cleaner attribution.
Run paid media and events with full autonomy, proposing and executing budget and calendar changes without waiting on sign-off.
Ship at least three new or rebuilt nurture and re-engagement tracks, with early performance data on each.
Rebuild or upgrade the dashboards used for weekly pipeline calls.
Build a working rhythm with Sales, RevOps, and Product Marketing so hand-offs, routing, and lead flow don't require chasing people down.

Own a program for paid media, events, and HubSpot that runs noticeably better than the one you inherited, with clear before and after numbers on channel efficiency and cost per qualified opportunity.
Be the person others trust when they want to know how well our campaigns and events are actually performing.
Have made real budget and channel calls, moving spend into what works and cutting what doesn't, with pipeline impact you can point to.
Have built a foundation that doesn't need rebuilding when volume doubles.
Have identified where the team needs more support, whether that's tooling, headcount, or an agency change, and made the case for it.

We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit.

Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.
The impact you'll make
As Upside's Product Marketer focused on Product Commercialization, you will work at the intersection of our Product and Retailer Go-to-market (RGTM) teams to shape how retailers think about our product. Internally, your work will drive cohesion and clarity across teams. Externally, your work will drive both product adoption and top-line revenue growth by acting as the voice of the retailer during product development, and by leading the commercialization of products and feature releases.

Champion the voice of the retailer , using market and competitive research to highlight opportunities in the product strategy.
Ensure internal alignment by acting as the primary liaison between the Product and Retailer Go to Market (RGTM) teams, to champion the voice of the retailer and align on roadmap priorities
Define our internal product GTM hierarchy in order to ensure effective and impactful launches and positive retailer reception
Contribute to our pricing strategy so that our price point reflects the product's value, covers costs, and meets retailers’ expectations
Drive adoption of new products and features among target prospects, channel partners, and the existing Upside retailer partners
Help to discover and document new product use-cases based on retailer pain points that could turn into new solutions and product offerings
Partner with Revenue Enablement to ensure the Sales and Accounts teams are equipped to tell the product story and accelerate conversion and expansion opportunities
What you should have
7+ years of experience in product marketing, sales enablement, or a related role —preferably in B2B, SaaS, or a high-growth tech environment. Experience with marketplaces is a plus.
A proven understanding of product commercialization and experience developing strategies to drive product adoption

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready AI solutions that help financial services firms transform how they operate, manage risk and deliver better outcomes for their customers.
We’re looking for a PR & Marketing Executive to help build Aveni’s profile across the UK financial services market and support the delivery of our PR, communications and wider marketing activity.
This is a varied, hands-on role for someone who knows what makes a good story, enjoys building relationships with journalists and wants to develop their career at the intersection of AI, fintech and financial services.

Working closely with the Head of PR & Communications, you’ll help tell Aveni’s story to the market, building relationships with journalists and industry influencers, identifying opportunities for Aveni to contribute to the conversation and securing relevant media coverage.
You’ll support the development of proactive PR campaigns, commentary and thought leadership around Aveni’s business priorities, product developments, customer successes and the wider issues shaping financial services.
The role goes beyond traditional media relations. You’ll also contribute to customer stories, executive and internal communications, events, awards, speaker opportunities, analyst relations and wider marketing campaigns.
You’ll work across Aveni, collaborating with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior leadership to make sure our communications are timely, consistent and aligned with our brand and market positioning.
What you’ll be doing
You’ll build and maintain relationships with journalists across UK business, financial services, fintech, compliance, risk and technology media, proactively pitching stories, commentary, interviews and contributed content.
You’ll support the development and delivery of PR campaigns around Aveni’s business priorities, product launches, research, customer stories and relevant market developments.
You’ll help run Aveni’s day-to-day press office, responding to journalist enquiries, identifying commentary opportunities, coordinating interviews and preparing briefing materials.
You’ll maintain our communications and editorial calendar across PR, thought leadership, research, webinars, awards, speaking opportunities and company announcements.
You’ll work with Sales and Customer Success to identify and develop compelling customer stories, case studies, testimonials and joint communications.
You’ll support internal communications, helping colleagues stay informed about company news, customer wins, product developments, events and media coverage.
You’ll work with Aveni’s senior leaders and subject matter experts to build their external profiles through LinkedIn content, commentary, talking points and other communications.
You’ll support our thought leadership programme, helping develop webinars, research reports, whitepapers and other content around the issues that matter to our market.
You’ll identify and coordinate relevant conference, panel, podcast and webinar speaking opportunities, as well as industry awards.
You’ll support our relationships with industry analysts and research organisations and help coordinate analyst briefings and materials.
You’ll work with the wider Marketing team to support conferences, roundtables, webinars and customer events.

You’ll have solid experience in PR, communications or a closely related role, with experience working in a B2B environment.
You’ll have experience dealing directly with journalists and proactively pitching stories and ideas.
You’ll be a strong writer and editor, comfortable producing press releases, pitches, commentary and other external communications.
You’ll have strong news judgement and be able to identify what makes a compelling story and how to tailor it for different audiences.
You’ll be confident communicating with journalists, senior stakeholders and external partners.

Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager – Foundation Pillar
Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing

6sense is the GTM Intelligence Platform, and Foundation is the layer the rest of it stands on — "platform, data, infrastructure: the backbone everything builds on." It owns account and people data, matching and identity, the APIs and MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and the workflows that move data through the system. When buyers ask whether 6sense is accurate, extensible, secure, and composable, the answer lives here.
We're looking for a Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for the Foundation pillar. This is the most technical seat on the PMM team.

You'll translate deep capabilities — identity resolution, data coverage and accuracy, API extensibility, the MCP framework, security and compliance — into differentiated stories that win over the technical and economic buyers who scrutinize them: RevOps architects, IT and security teams, data leaders, and increasingly developers building agentic GTM stacks.
You'll also carry one of the most strategically important narratives in the company: that 6sense is a composable intelligence layer other systems and AI agents plug into — "AI to the data, not data to the AI" — rather than a closed destination. With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly.
What You'll Own
Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.
Technical proof. Turn capability into credibility: architecture explainers, technical briefs and whitepapers, benchmarks, and reference narratives that substantiate the "backbone everything builds on" claim — especially around data accuracy, coverage, and identity resolution.
The composable / MCP-agent story. Own the infrastructure-layer narrative — 6sense as the data and intelligence layer that agentic GTM stacks compose with. Lead GTM for the MCP framework and the developer / technical-buyer audience it opens up.
Differentiation for the data and identity layer. Make the case against point data providers and infrastructure alternatives — coverage, match rates, identity quality, enrichment, security posture — and arm the field to win on it.
Field and partner enablement for technical evaluations. Build the battlecards, objection handling, FAQs, and solution content that win RFPs, security reviews, and technical POCs. Partner with Sales Engineering to make the technical buyer's diligence a place 6sense wins.
Launches. Drive end-to-end GTM for Foundation releases: new data assets, API and MCP capabilities, security packages (SCIM, SSO role mapping, audit, custom roles), connectors, and workflow features.
Cross-functional partnership. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Foundation Product and Engineering leaders to shape roadmap-to-market, and with Customer Success to surface the post-sale and admin/security use cases that prove the platform's breadth.
Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations.

8+ years in product marketing, technical product management, or a closely related function, with substantial technical PMM experience for platform, data, infrastructure, API, or developer products.
A proven ability to translate technical concepts — APIs, data pipelines, identity resolution, integrations, security, and AI/agent architectures like MCP — into crisp positioning and business value, without losing the engineers in the room or the buyers outside it.
A track record owning messaging for technical products and enabling technical sales motions (Sales Engineering, RFPs, security reviews, POCs).
Hands-on, not hand-wavy. You'll personally call the APIs, stand up and configure the MCP server, connect it to an agent, and build the demo — and your messaging is sharper because you've done the thing, not just read the spec.
Strong writing — you can produce content that is technically rigorous and genuinely clear, from a one-line value prop to an architecture whitepaper.
Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, or data platforms, and comfort selling to technical and economic buyers (RevOps architects, IT, security, data teams, developers).
The judgment and presence to operate as a senior individual contributor: set strategy, lead cross-functionally without authority, and influence product and executive stakeholders.

Hands-on familiarity with data enrichment and identity (waterfall enrichment, matching, intent data), MCP and agentic AI architectures, or composable/API-first platforms.
Experience marketing to developers or technical evaluators, including documentation-adjacent and developer-community work.
Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 6–12 months, Foundation has a differentiated, defensible position that technical buyers recognize; the composable/MCP infrastructure story is landed with the field and the market as something that exists today, not a roadmap promise; the data and identity credibility story is substantiated with proof, not assertion; and the field has the enablement to win the technical evaluation every time it comes.

Creators use these models to build everything from a single 3D object to an entire playable world, reaching tens of millions of people every day. Improve activation, time to first campaign, retention, repeat spend, reactivation, and expansion. Scale effective programs and use AI to accelerate content, personalization, and analysis.

Demonstrate a track record of building and leading lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, with measurable activation, retention, or customer-growth results.

Lead cross-functional programs with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Marketing Operations, aligning priorities and driving delivery.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to see people who have built their skills both inside and outside the marketing discipline.
Over the past ~4 years, we’ve gone from a stealth brand to the default operating system for over 5,000 of the most ambitious companies in tech, finance, and healthcare.

On this journey, we’ve also amassed a marketing team of ~30 folks from across North America and Europe who are some of the brightest and most humble humans that want to ‘win’, and have fun doing so.

Our culture is focused on creating a space to do lots of career-defining work with the tools, people, and focus that means minimal thrash and lots of autonomy. You can learn a little more about how we work here and why our investors are excited about us here .
For this role, we are looking for someone to lead demand generation for our enterprise segment in Europe. You will have a fantastic thought partner and US counterpart, Ben , as well as the autonomy to rethink and define the strategy and execution to fit the nuances of the different European markets.

It’s ABM but not in its traditional form: we’re seeking a first-principles thinker who prioritizes meaningful engagement over generic tactics / outdated playbooks (for example, prioritizing a few key impactful moments of engagement over running a laundry list of generic tactics across digital channels).
If working with both the sales and marketing team to find and convert enterprise pipeline in a low ego, highly ambitious environment appeals, we’d love to hear from you!
What you’ll be responsible for in this role
Partner with Ben to define our EMEA enterprise ABM strategy and the channels we bet on with consideration to broader global strategy and nuances of respective European markets. Here you play the critical role of orchestrator, pulling together all of the relevant marketing channels to support a delightful discovery and prospect journey and are the point person for your counterparts in Sales.
Research and build prospect journey maps for target accounts, and develop the messaging, content, and creative that bring them to life, with support from our PMM, content, and creative teams.
Work with sales and revenue operations to build target account lists that combine data signals with rep input, and own the methodology behind them — how cohorts are built, what assumptions they rest on, and how we measure whether accounts are actually moving.
Manage our agency partners, including our gifting agency, Wildcard, to get campaigns executed well and fast.
Execute on the strategy you define which will include activities like working with your events counterpart on the coordination of dinners, activations , ancillary conference events, and stunts.
Apply our experimentation framework to run short sprints, learn quickly what works, and localise content, creative, and campaign strategy for EMEA markets.

s.h: You will probably love this role if
s.t:
You enjoy combining data and creative thinking — and you have taste. You can tell the difference between messaging that's genuinely compelling and messaging that's generic or cheesy.
You're prospect-obsessed. You can step into the seat of the personas you're marketing to and build campaigns that meet them where they are, at the right time, with the right message.
You are deeply curious and not afraid to break from traditional ABM playbooks.
You build trust across functions. Sales managers and reps are excited to work with you, and the marketing team is fully bought into your campaign ideas and asks.
You understand (and leverage) the massive advantage AI creates but not so pilled that you let efficiency gains undercut creativity and taste.

s.h: This role is not for you if
s.t:
You'd rely solely on 6sense (or equivalent) as your only source of truth.
You're strong on one half of the job but not the other. You need to move comfortably between building and interpreting dashboards, and writing compelling copy and developing creative with our gifting agency and creative teams.
You lean heavily on existing playbooks and tactics rather than stepping back and thinking from first principles. A lot of how we market at Ashby is deliberately different; curiosity and adaptability are critical.
You aren't able to operate with autonomy and run strategies end-to-end. We give clear ownership and trust you with it; you should be proactive and resourceful.
You believe that EMEA is one homogeneous market

Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!
Unsere Vision
Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.
Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.
Über uns
Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

s.h: In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht
s.t:
💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.
💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.
🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.
🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.
🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!
Deine Mission
Pennylane ist in Frankreich bereits einer der führenden Anbieter für Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware – in Deutschland stehen wir noch am Anfang unserer Reise.
Als Content & Communications Manager Germany gestaltest du maßgeblich, wie Pennylane im deutschen Markt wahrgenommen wird. Du entwickelst unsere lokale Content-Strategie weiter und übersetzt komplexe Themen rund um Produkt, Buchhaltung und Marktveränderungen in relevante, verständliche und überzeugende Inhalte .
Dabei geht es nicht darum, französischen Content einfach zu übersetzen: Du entwickelst eine Kommunikation, die zum deutschen Markt, unseren Zielgruppen und gleichzeitig zur Marke Pennylane passt.
Du bist Teil unseres internationalen Brand Teams und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Sales, Product und Events zusammen.
Deine Aufgaben
Content & Editorial
Du entwickelst unseren LinkedIn-Content und Redaktionskalender für Deutschland weiter und definierst relevante Content-Pillars rund um unser Produkt, E-Rechnung, Markttrends und weitere Themen.
Du entwickelst Case Studies und Customer Stories – sowohl als Video als auch in schriftlicher Form – und baust daraus einen strukturierten Repurposing-Ansatz auf.
Du konzipierst hochwertige Lead Magnets , Guides, Artikel und weitere Formate für Steuerberatungskanzleien und KMU.
Du baust unseren deutschen Newsletter mit auf und entwickelst relevante Themen und Formate.
Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Produktion unseres Podcasts .
Du adaptierst erfolgreiche internationale Inhalte für Deutschland – nicht als reine Übersetzung, sondern passend zu Markt, Zielgruppe und kulturellem Kontext.
Product & Sales Content
Du arbeitest eng mit Product Marketing, Product und Sales zusammen und entwickelst Content rund um Produktneuheiten, Launches und relevante Marktthemen .
Du machst aus komplexen Produkt-, regulatorischen und buchhalterischen Themen Inhalte, die einfach zu verstehen und gerne zu lesen sind.
Du entwickelst Sales-Enablement-Materialien wie Pitch Decks, One-Pager, Product Stories und weitere Assets, die unser Sales-Team im Alltag unterstützen.
Du greifst wiederkehrende Fragen, Einwände und Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen auf und übersetzt sie in wiederverwendbaren Content.
Events & Communications
Du entwickelst Content für Events, Webinare und Konferenzen – von Social Posts und E-Mails bis hin zu Präsentationen, Eventseiten und Materialien vor Ort.
Du unterstützt die Kommunikation vor, während und nach unseren Events und sorgst für einen konsistenten Markenauftritt.
Content Operations
Du baust gemeinsam mit dem deutschen und internationalen Team klare Content-Prozesse und Redaktionspläne auf.
Du koordinierst bei Bedarf Designer, Freelancer, Agenturen und weitere externe Partner.
Du nutzt AI-Tools sinnvoll für Recherche, Drafting, Repurposing und Lokalisierung , ohne dabei Qualität, Genauigkeit und unsere Tonalität aus den Augen zu verlieren.
Du analysierst, welche Themen und Formate funktionieren, und entwickelst unseren Content kontinuierlich weiter.
Dein Profil
Du schreibst und sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verfügst über sehr gute professionelle Englischkenntnisse.
Du bringst ca. 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Content, Communications, Product Marketing, Brand Content oder B2B Marketing mit.
Du hast Erfahrung darin, für eine B2B-Zielgruppe zu schreiben – idealerweise in SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Accounting oder einem anderen erklärungsbedürftigen bzw. regulierten Umfeld.
Du kannst komplexe Informationen schnell erfassen und daraus klare, relevante und überzeugende Geschichten entwickeln.
Du hast ein sehr gutes redaktionelles Gespür und weißt, was eine Botschaft wirklich braucht – und was man besser weglässt.
Du bist strukturiert und kannst mehrere Themen und Projekte gleichzeitig priorisieren und vorantreiben.
Du fühlst dich wohl dabei, mit unterschiedlichen Teams wie Brand, Product, Sales, Growth und Events zusammenzuarbeiten.
Du brauchst nicht für alles ein perfektes Briefing: Du stellst die richtigen Fragen, schaffst Klarheit und kommst ins Handeln.
Du arbeitest sorgfältig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch, ohne dabei Geschwindigkeit und Pragmatismus zu verlieren.

Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer Marke in einem neuen Markt, Kenntnisse im Bereich Content Repurposing und AI-gestützter Content-Prozesse sowie Erfahrung in einem internationalen Umfeld.
Warum diese Rolle besonders ist
Deutschland ist für Pennylane ein strategisch wichtiger Wachstumsmarkt. Gleichzeitig sind wir hier noch eine vergleichsweise junge Marke.
Das bedeutet: Du übernimmst nicht einfach einen bestehenden Content-Kalender, sondern kannst mitgestalten, wie Pennylane in Deutschland spricht, welche Geschichten wir erzählen und wie wir Vertrauen bei Steuerberatungskanzleien und Unternehmen aufbauen.
Du bekommst dafür die Erfahrung, Brand-Grundlagen und Ressourcen unseres internationalen Teams – und gleichzeitig viel Raum, eine Kommunikation zu entwickeln, die sich wirklich nach dem deutschen Markt anfühlt.
Wenn du gerne nah am Markt und am Produkt arbeitest, komplexe Themen verständlich machst und lieber Dinge umsetzt, als sie monatelang in Präsentationen zu diskutieren, könnte diese Rolle sehr gut zu dir passen.

Bei Pennylane sind Events ein wichtiger Bestandteil unserer Marketingstrategie. Deshalb suchen wir unsere*n erste*n Event Manager*in für den deutschen Markt mit Sitz in Berlin.

Gleichzeitig arbeitest du Hand in Hand mit dem Germany Marketer, um unsere Eventaktivitäten optimal mit den lokalen Marketinginitiativen abzustimmen. Gemeinsam stellt ihr sicher, dass sich jedes Event in unsere übergreifende Marketingstrategie einfügt und gleichzeitig auf die Besonderheiten und Erwartungen des deutschen Marktes zugeschnitten ist.

Du koordinierst die Teams vor Ort und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf der gesamten Veranstaltung.

Du beobachtest Markttrends und erkennst relevante Chancen frühzeitig, um einen passenden Eventkalender zu entwickeln.
Du konzipierst Eventformate passend zu unseren Zielen und den verfügbaren Budgets.

Du koordinierst alle organisatorischen Schritte und stellst sicher, dass Deadlines und vertragliche Verpflichtungen eingehalten werden.

Develop and own the digital-channel Joint Business Plans with Sales.

· Align plans with the Brand Media and Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) teams to maximise the efficiency and impact of total marketing investment, working with them to adjust plans where necessary due to commercial or operational blocks.

· Champion data- and AI-driven commercial planning to sharpen investment decisions, forecasting and prioritisation.
Commercial, Social & Growth

· Bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, spotting opportunities and gaps, developing retailer campaigns and propositions that turn existing and incremental marketing budget into substantial uplifts in product orders and strong return on investment, and partnering and leading with your Sales counterparts (including the Senior Sales Director, Pureplay) and retailers on these conversations.

· Own the digital shelf and content excellence agenda (PDPs, brand stores, search and content) and ensure flawless GTM and NPD support, with assets, listings and launch readiness delivered in time and aligned to launch dates.

Budget & Performance

· Set the standard for measurement and reporting, ensuring your team reports spend and performance accurately and on time each week to the Head of Retail Marketing and the wider UKI Leadership team, where it feeds into regional and global visibility.
Leadership & Collaboration

What we do.
Imagine every product on the internet, instantly available to you.
You could take anything from any online shop, resell it, and earn from it . Every influencer could sell the products they already use and love , without ever touching a warehouse. You could spend your Payback points or miles on something you actually want , instead of another forgettable knife set. And your AI could buy any product in the world for you, without your intervention .
We built exactly that. It's live, and it's running today.
Joy_'s AI infrastructure runs the entire e-commerce value chain end to end : sourcing, checkout, payment, fulfillment, customer care, and returns. Across any online shop on the planet. No merchant contracts, no APIs, no closed networks. This is our Universal Purchasing Infrastructure , and it sits right at the center of where AI commerce is going.
On top of it, we build our own business models. The first one live and proven: the gift card .
That's a 20 billion euro market in Germany alone , the single most-gifted thing in the country, and nobody has innovated on it in years. Now there's a gift card you can redeem for any product, from any shop, for any wish .
We've raised from top European funds and angels who've built and scaled some of the most relevant tech and commerce companies around.
Behind it all: a mixed team of twelve, spread across Europe, with a strong center and our office in Berlin.
The technology is done. What we need now is the other half: the narrative, the brand, the story that makes people feel it. That's the job.
Aufgaben

In short: You own the feeling people get in the first 10 seconds. The instant, can't-look-away pull of an Oatly or TrueFruits ad, but for gifting.
This is the rare shot at building a category-defining brand from zero, the kind a whole country ends up recognizing. Everything below serves that.
And to be clear about the shape of the work: you're fluent with data. You read the dashboards and you know exactly what each channel converts. But creation comes first. What we're really hiring for is the instinct to make something loud, something the whole country notices. You build campaigns end to end, from the idea that stops the scroll to the dashboard that proves it worked.
Build the new narrative and positioning. With completely new technology we've lifted the gift card to a whole new level. Your job: tell that story, set us apart from every other gift card, and own the narrative for the new alternative.
Tell the product story. Our card is so good it reads as too good to be true. You make it believable, playing on our "Zu-Gut-Schein" framing, the gift card that's almost too good, and always making clear how it actually works.
Own our two biggest growth channels: TV and Social. This is where we scale. TV and Out of Home put your work in front of millions, on screens and billboards a whole country walks past, and on the retail shelves the card sits on. On Social, you run our own channels plus a TikTok UGC engine that multiplies everything we make.

What you ship isn't a small post for a small feed. When you get it right, a whole country sees it. We start national, but international is already on the map: UK and US are the planned next step, and the brand you build needs to travel.
Hold brand consistency. Narrative and story run through everything we ship, verbally and visually, with no drift. One unmistakable Joy_, everywhere.
Make it convert. In the end, conversion is what counts. You stay fully data-driven, keep the conversion rates per channel in view, and double down on what actually moves them.
Qualifikation
What makes a good fit.
We're not reading your CV for the logos or the degree. We want to see what you've actually built. Show us the creative things you've already pulled off, whether at a past job or on your own time. That's what we're reading for.

s.h: A few traits make it click
s.t:
You've built a brand before, at least 3 years of it. From near zero, or as a core part of the team, ideally in consumer, retail, or culture, for a brand made to reach everyone, not a narrow niche. You know how a campaign works end to end, and you can run the channels that carry it.
You have taste. For brand, for content, for social, for the zeitgeist. You instinctively sense what fits the narrative and what breaks it, verbally, visually, aesthetically, and you know what the internet finds good this week, not last year.
Social media is your daily life, and you've worked with creators and influencers. You know how social actually works from the inside: what makes a collab feel real, what makes it flop, and how to brief people who live on camera.
Bonus: you've run our growth channels yourself. TV and Out of Home, and above all a TikTok UGC engine you built and steered. If you've already stood up your own creator army and made it perform, that's a massive plus.
You're bold in what you ship. In the ideas and concepts you put out, and in the brand language itself. You want to do things in a way nobody has yet.
You make things yourself. You have taste and hands. You can write the script, cut the reel, and build the Notion doc in the same hour.
Insane agency and ownership. You turn chaos into clarity and you'd rather ship rough than wait for permission.
AI-native instincts. You create videos and creative assets with AI without breaking a sweat. The tools change weekly and you don't care, you bend whatever is newest to make more, faster.
Fluency in German and English is a must.

What's in it for you.
🌱 Ownership. The whole brand and marketing surface is yours, working side by side with the founders every day. Real budget for ideas, including 10% of your time for the remarkable stuff (our Blue Slide principle).
🚀 Growth. Work on the frontier of consumer brand-building alongside senior operators and engineers who've built and scaled before.
💡 Autonomy. Remote-first with the freedom to work how you work best.
🎁 Meaningful equity. We want you to win with us.
🛍️ Real impact. See what you build go live across product, campaigns, and shelves. Fast.
Why this role is truly different.
Most brand jobs are about polishing something that already exists, or squeezing a funnel someone else built. This one is a blank canvas, and it's yours to go wild on.
We're young and we want to be loud. The gift card is dusty, an afterthought, the thing people grab when nothing better came to mind, and nobody has touched it in years. We're the fresh, loud opposite, the brand that flips a tired category on its head and ruffles a few feathers doing it. You get the full creative range to live that out, sitting directly with the co-founders with the whole brand surface yours from day one.
Here's why this role outranks everything else in marketing: Joy_ is bought on occasion, not on inspiration. Nobody wakes up wanting a gift card. People buy when a birthday or a thank-you lands on them, and they reach for whatever name is already in their head. So we have to get there first. That makes brand awareness our single most important channel and our biggest priority , and it comes with real budget .

You have owned marketing end to end at a small business, a startup, or directly for founders. Not a slice of a large corporate marketing department. If your best work was one channel inside a big company, this will not suit you and we would rather say so now
Real depth in one or two areas. SEO and content, or Meta and paid social, or email and lifecycle, or analytics and attribution. Be excellent at something
Numbers you can defend. Not "improved engagement". What was it before, what was it after, what did the business get, and how do you know. You will be asked to walk through a campaign in detail, including what it cost per lead and why that figure is credible
Technical by instinct. You pick up new tools quickly, you have built things yourself, and you use AI because you understand what it can do, not because it is fashionable
You deliver alone. Remote, lightly managed, off a written brief, on time
Experienced enough to have been there and done it. This is not a first or second marketing job

ActiveCampaign specifically, though any serious automation platform transfers
Event marketing
Podcast or video production
Experience marketing a B2B service to business leaders
Two things we will ask you directly
What else are you contracted to do? This is a full-time role and it has to be your only one. We ask everybody, and we ask it first.
Walk me through a campaign you ran, with the numbers. Three of them, with the starting point as well as the finish. If you cannot do that from memory, do not apply yet.
What you get
Full ownership of marketing delivery at a company selling the thing every business is currently trying to work out, with a fractional CMO who knows what he wants and tells you clearly. Full-time, permanent, UK hours, paid in rands into a South African account. Employed through Remote Recruitment , working as part of the client's team.
Equipment
Reliable laptop, stable fibre, quiet professional home working setup.
Process
A recorded screening interview with us, then a task and a final conversation with the founder and the fractional CMO. You will hear back within 24 hours of every stage.

Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
Our Growth Marketing team within the Consumer & Business group scales Coinbase's customer base and revenue through data-driven, full-funnel acquisition strategies across paid channels globally. Own end-to-end global strategy and execution across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit) and mobile user acquisition (mobile display) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets.
Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and app store/landing experiences; translate results into scaled playbooks for global markets.
Partner with Data Science and Analytics to design experiments, incrementality tests, and mobile measurement frameworks (MMM, SKAN, MMP-based) that connect paid social and mobile UA performance to downstream business outcomes.

Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting for paid social and mobile UA spend, with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel; proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Creative, Data Science, and regional teams.

You'll join the Brand Marketing team in Amsterdam and help shape how HelloFresh shows up across our digital channels in the Benelux. As Content Marketing Specialist, you'll work on the content our customers see every week (emails, landing pages, the app) making sure the right message reaches the right audience at every stage of the funnel.
You'll work alongside both local and global teams to keep our tone of voice sharp and consistent across markets. And you'll help us find better, faster ways to produce content, including with AI.

Write clear, engaging copy for different audiences, channels, and stages of the customer journey, with an eye on both product and conversion.
Execute our content strategy across email, landing pages, the app, and touchpoints like social media and the printed booklet.
Manage the content calendar alongside the team, coordinating campaigns, product updates, and always-on communications so everything lands on time.
Review and approve content with a sharp eye for accuracy and consistency — and adjust visual designs when needed.
Track content performance and turn customer and campaign data into concrete recommendations for what we do next.
Brief agencies and cross-functional teams on what campaigns need, and keep everyone aligned along the way.
Experiment with new tools and technologies, including AI, to make content creation, localization, and quality control more effective.

0-2 years of experience in content management, online marketing, or CRM.
Strong writing and communication skills in Dutch and English.
Precision and attention to detail — you catch the things others miss.
An interest in brand strategy and in what makes customers click, convert, and stay.
The ability to manage several projects and stakeholders at once in a fast-moving environment.
Curiosity about new tools and technologies, including AI, and how they can make marketing better.
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.

As Principal PMM, you'll own the overarching AI and Orchestration Innovation narrative for Iterable, connecting individual capabilities into a single, compelling point of view on where AI-driven customer engagement is headed and why Iterable wins.

Own the AI Narrative

Craft Messaging
Craft bold, narrative-driven messaging and positioning that connects AI and orchestration innovation to tangible customer value.
Write the Tier 1 launch messaging for flagship AI releases, setting the story every other asset needs to ladder back to.
Review and give direction on launch content and campaigns across the team, ensuring every asset ladders back to the launch narrative rather than drifting into its own
Market Intelligence

Adoption & Customer Success
Drive customer adoption and expansion of AI capabilities through lifecycle messaging and targeted enablement
Partner with customer marketing and CS on reference stories and case studies that prove out the AI narrative with real customers

Experience marketing an AI-native or agentic product, or a platform transitioning from feature-based to AI-managed experiences
Exceptional storytelling: a track record of shaping the strategic "why" behind a launch and translating it into messaging that sells

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.
Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.
DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.
DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.
Job Title: Federal Marketing Specialist
Location: Remote

DeleteMe is looking for a Public Sector Marketing Specialist to help coordinate and execute marketing programs supporting our growing Public Sector business across federal, state, and local government.
This is a hands-on marketing generalist role for someone who enjoys bringing programs to life, keeping cross-functional work moving, and adapting great marketing to different audiences. You'll serve as a key connection point between our Public Sector go-to-market team and broader Marketing organization, partnering closely with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Sales, and other teams to make sure Public Sector has the campaigns, content, events, and materials it needs to succeed.
You don't need to be a government subject matter expert or come in ready to build a Public Sector marketing strategy from scratch. Instead, we're looking for a strong marketer and project manager who can take existing DeleteMe messaging and programs, thoughtfully adapt them for Public Sector audiences, and coordinate execution from start to finish.
This is a great opportunity for someone early to mid-career who wants broad exposure across marketing while taking meaningful ownership of an important and growing part of DeleteMe's business.

-Coordinate Public Sector marketing programs across federal, state, and local government, helping translate broader marketing priorities into programs and deliverables that support the Public Sector go-to-market team.
-Adapt existing marketing content and messaging for Public Sector audiences, including one-pagers, presentations, case studies, email campaigns, event materials, and sales collateral.
-Partner closely with Product Marketing to ensure Public Sector messaging and materials are accurate, consistent, and aligned with DeleteMe's broader positioning while reducing the need for one-off customization by the PMM team.
-Support Field Marketing and event execution, coordinating DeleteMe's presence at conferences, industry events, dinners, and other Public Sector programs.
-Own event logistics and coordination, including booth preparation, material and swag shipments, vendor coordination, registrations, scheduling, dinner logistics, and on-site support.
-Represent DeleteMe at events and help ensure a polished, consistent experience for prospects, customers, partners, and other attendees.
-Partner with Public Sector Sales and GTM teams to understand upcoming needs, gather requirements, prioritize requests, and coordinate delivery of marketing materials and programs.
-Manage multiple projects and requests simultaneously, establishing timelines, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring deliverables move from request through completion.
-Identify opportunities to standardize and scale Public Sector marketing materials, reducing repetitive one-off work and creating reusable resources for the GTM organization.
-Track program and event performance and share learnings with Marketing and Public Sector stakeholders to help improve future execution.

-A minimum of 2–5 years of marketing experience, ideally in a B2B, SaaS, technology, cybersecurity, or similarly fast-moving environment.
-Experience working as a marketing generalist with exposure to multiple areas such as field marketing, events, content, campaigns, product marketing, or sales enablement.
-Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables at once.
-Experience adapting existing messaging and content for different audiences rather than relying exclusively on creating new content from scratch.
-Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

Work as part of a matrix organisation, collaborating with Brand, Growth, Product, Finance, and regional General Managers to align a broad set of stakeholders around shared goals and trade-offs.
